name: Mujo Bar & Restaurant
address: 1 Knysna Road, Glenwood AH, George, 6529, South Africa
description_short: Contemporary Asian fusion in George's Glenwood, where sushi meets Korean BBQ in a stylish setting.
description_long:
Mujo Bar & Restaurant brings a taste of Asia to George's Glenwood neighbourhood, serving up an ambitious menu that spans Japanese, Korean, and pan-Asian flavours. The modern space appeals to a younger crowd looking for something beyond traditional Garden Route fare, with sushi platters, Korean BBQ options, and fusion dishes that lean into bold flavours and generous portions.

The menu does a lot – perhaps too much for purists – but regulars appreciate the variety, especially the fresh sushi rolls and the interactive Korean BBQ experience. Service can be hit-and-miss during busy periods, but the relaxed vibe and decent pricing make it a solid choice when you're craving something different. The bar selection complements the food well, with sake, Asian beers, and cocktails that lean into the theme.

Located just off the main George road network, Mujo has become a go-to for groups and casual dinners where everyone can find something they'll enjoy. It's not trying to be fine dining, and that's part of its charm – just good Asian-inspired food in a town where those options are limited.
